dismissible.description: Whether a person may dismiss it; true unless critical, which never is.

ends_at.description: When it stops showing, after it starts.

link.description: Where it leads: a path in the web app, such as /help/…, or an https address.

message.description: What it says, in plain words.
examples: The office is closed on 3 November; bills due that day are paid on 4 November.

roles.description: The roles it shows to; leave it out for everyone.

items.description: A role of PRD-001 §7.1, such as owner, accountant or bookkeeper.

severity.description: info, warning, or critical for what everyone must see.

starts_at.description: When it starts showing, now or later; leave it out to start now.
